tagline: Building stockholder value through returns-focused development of natural gas, NGLs and oil properties
hero_kpi_rationale: The company's main driver is the controlled growth of its natural gas production, supported by a portfolio of high-return projects in the Marcellus basin.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue — total sales generated over the period.
kpis.description: Revenue grew 27% in 2025 thanks to higher realized prices (+24%) and slight production growth (+2%). Exact amount: $2,815,591 thousand.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net Income — bottom-line profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income came in at $658.0 million in 2025 versus $266.3 million in 2024, an increase of 147% driven by higher realized prices and slightly higher production.

kpis.name: Average Daily Production (mcfe)
kpis.explanation: Production — total physical output over the period.
kpis.description: La production moyenne quotidienne s'est établie à 2,24 milliards de pieds cubes équivalent gaz (Bcfe) en 2025, en hausse de 2,5 % par rapport à 2024 (2,18 Bcfe).

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Capital Expenditures — investments in property, plant and equipment.
kpis.description: Le capex 2025 s'est établi à 673,8 millions de dollars, dans la fourchette annoncée de 650 à 690 millions, avec un focus sur les projets à haut rendement.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.explanation: Free Cash Flow — operating cash flow minus capital expenditures.
kpis.description: Estimated at about $526 million ($1.2 billion of operating cash flow less $674 million of capex), sharply higher versus 2024, reflecting the combination of higher prices and higher production.
kpis.signal: Cash generation improving, financial flexibility rising

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant versé aux actionnaires par action chaque année.
kpis.description: The annual dividend was raised to $0.36 per share in 2025, versus $0.32 in 2024, reflecting confidence in durable cash flow generation.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total Assets — sum of all assets on the balance sheet.
kpis.description: Total des actifs extrait yfinance sur les 4 dernières années.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.explanation: Total Debt — sum of short-term and long-term borrowings.
kpis.description: Dette totale extrait yfinance sur les 4 dernières années.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.description: Dividend per share paid annually, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.explanation: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders through annual dividends, sourced from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 reported fiscal years.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

stories_kpis.name: Natural Gas Price Realization
stories_kpis.explanation: Prix moyen NYMEX perçu pour le gaz naturel vendu.
stories_kpis.description: The average NYMEX gas price realized in 2025 reached $3.43/mcf versus $2.27/mcf in 2024, driven by higher LNG exports and lower overall supply.
stories_kpis.signal: Fort rebond des prix du gaz en 2025

stories_kpis.name: Oil Price Realization
stories_kpis.explanation: Prix moyen NYMEX perçu pour le baril de pétrole vendu.
stories_kpis.description: The average NYMEX oil price fell to $64.52/barrel in 2025 versus $76.17 in 2024, amid global overproduction.
stories_kpis.signal: Baisse des prix du pétrole en 2025

stories_kpis.name: Operating Cash Flow
stories_kpis.explanation: Trésorerie générée par les activités opérationnelles avant investissements.
stories_kpis.description: The company generated $1.2 billion of operating cash flow in 2025, or $226.8 million more than in 2024, reflecting higher realized prices and higher production volumes.
stories_kpis.signal: Robust cash generation supported by high prices

ai_positioning.summary: La société RRC ne mentionne pas l'intelligence artificielle ou l'apprentissage automatique dans son rapport 10-K. Les informations fournies se concentrent sur les aspects financiers, les réserves de gaz naturel et les opérations de la société.

risks.title: Volatilité des prix des matières premières
risks.summary: Les fluctuations des prix du gaz naturel, du pétrole et des NGL affectent directement les revenus, la rentabilité et la stratégie d'investissement de la société.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is repeated several times in the document, notably in the 'Market Conditions' and 'Overview of Our Business' sections, with strong language highlighting the direct impact on revenue, cash, reserves and the ability to raise funds. It is considered fundamental for RRC's business model. The Macro category carries high weight.

risks.title: Litiges et réclamations réglementaires
risks.summary: The company faces several ongoing lawsuits common in the sector, notably environmental and contractual claims, which could generate financial costs.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the 'Legal Proceedings' section, with acknowledgement of several ongoing actions (royalties, contracts, environment). Although the company states that the impact will not be material, the risk of sanctions >$250,000 is explicitly cited, indicating non-negligible exposure.

risks.title: Risques environnementaux et sanctions
risks.summary: La société est exposée à des risques réglementaires environnementaux pouvant entraîner des amendes significatives ou des interruptions d'activité.
risks.score_rationale: The 'Environmental Proceedings' section indicates that violation notices are received regularly. The risk of sanctions >$250,000 is mentioned, with cautious language ('cannot predict with certainty'). Environmental regulation is a major issue for gas producers, increasing severity.

risks.title: Dépendance aux dérivés de couverture
risks.summary: L'utilisation de contrats dérivés pour couvrir une partie de la production comporte des risques financiers si les marchés évoluent défavorablement.
risks.score_rationale: The company partially relies on derivatives to mitigate price volatility, as indicated in 'Outlook for 2026'. Poor management or a counterparty default could expose the company to significant losses, especially in a context of heightened volatility.

risks.title: Concurrence pour l'accès aux infrastructures
risks.summary: Les limitations d'infrastructure et la concurrence pour l'accès aux réseaux de transport et d'exportation pèsent sur la rentabilité future de la production.
risks.score_rationale: In 'Market Conditions', the company mentions infrastructure constraints as a factor limiting natural gas growth. This affects the ability to export and to realize optimal prices, a strategic issue in the producing basins.

risks.title: Dépendance à la stratégie de consolidation des permis
risks.summary: Continued development depends on the ability to maintain and consolidate land positions in the Marcellus basin.
risks.score_rationale: The company invests in the renewal and consolidation of permits in Pennsylvania ($51.8M in 2025). Difficulty in maintaining or extending these positions could limit future development, although this is actively managed.

governance.voting_structure_note: Single class of common stock, 1 vote per share.
